notes: run.py builds a repo per run from `fixture`, runs `prompt` with `claude -p`, then copies the PR files from ~/.ai/<repo-slug>/prs/ to outputs/prs/, writes outputs/git-state.txt, and deletes ~/.ai/<repo-slug>/. `pr_*` checks read all PR files joined. `pr_body_*` checks read them without the frontmatter. `state_*` checks read git-state.txt: `main-head <subject>`, then for each branch except main, `branch <name>`, then `subject <s>` for each commit in main..<name>, then `ancestors <refs>`. Regexes are case-insensitive unless a check sets `case`, except `reply_*` checks. `@name` in `patterns` names a list in `pattern_sets`.

common_checks.text: Frontmatter has type, draft, base, and breaking
Body starts with an H1 title
Has no list with only one item
Has no hard line breaks in paragraphs or list items
Has no seeded slop words or long dashes

evals.name: small-fix
evals.prompt: /draft-pr I tested it on an emulator: a search for "milk" now finds the note "Milk and eggs".
evals.expected_output: A short fix PR: Context, Changes, Testing with the emulator check. No How to review, no High-impact changes, at most 1 review comment. The reply says that git-spice preparation was skipped.

checks.text: The fixture repo does not change
File name is the branch slug
Metadata: fix, not draft, base main, not breaking
Has no ticket field, because there is no ticket
Testing has the emulator check from the prompt
Has no review guide and no high-impact section
Has at most 1 review comment
Title has no code names
Reply has the 🧹 line
Reply has no manual check, split, or draft suggestion

evals.name: ui-screenshot-test
evals.expected_output: A feature PR. The description does not embed the changed reference image and tells that the image diff is in the changed files. The reply has no capture suggestion.

checks.text: The fixture repo does not change
Type is feature
Does not embed the reference image
Tells about the screenshot test image diff
Reply has no capture suggestion

evals.name: stack-fixup
evals.expected_output: The skill syncs, restacks, squashes the fixup! commit, and restacks the upper branch. The PR for tags-model has base main and an Out of scope that names the tags in the note list.

checks.text: File name is the branch slug
Base is main
No fixup! commit is left
main has the upstream commit, both branches contain main, and tags-in-list contains tags-model
Out of scope names the next branch of the stack
Reply has the 🧹 line

evals.name: pr-template
evals.prompt: /draft-pr I tested it on an emulator: a search for "milk" now finds the note "Milk and eggs".
evals.expected_output: The description uses the sections of docs/pull_request_template.md (Summary, How was this tested?, Checklist), not Context and Changes.

checks.text: The fixture repo does not change
Uses the template sections
Does not use the skill Context section
